page_title: ACM 1-0 VER | AC Milan v Verona 23/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Fabio Maresca is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+5' What a wasted opportunity by Luka Jovic (AC Milan)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Lorenzo Montipo makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
90+4' 4:2 – this is the current number of shots on target.
90+1' The resulting set piece from Verona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Filippo Terracciano is replaced by Milan Djuric (Verona).
89' Although Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) is just on the bench, Fabio Maresca has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
88' Juan David Cabal (Verona) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.

87' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Lorenzo Montipo makes a great save to stop the effort going into the middle of the goal.
85' Malick Thiaw (AC Milan) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
84' The attendance is 71070.

65' Olivier Giroud comes off the pitch to be replaced by Luka Jovic (AC Milan).
62' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) sends a chip pass into the box, but Lorenzo Montipo is quickest to intercept the ball.
61' Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
58' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
55' Federico Bonazzoli (Verona) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
54' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Verona.
51' Federico Bonazzoli (Verona) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
48' Fabio Maresca blows for a foul after Martin Hongla (Verona) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
47' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) probably handled the ball.
46' Marco Baroni makes a half-time substitution. Federico Bonazzoli (Verona) comes on in place of Davide Faraoni.
46' The second half gets underway.

45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
42' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
42' Yellow card. Davide Faraoni (Verona) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
41' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
39' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
37' The current number of shots on goal is 1:1.
35' Martin Hongla (Verona) serves up a nice cross, but Marco Sportiello punches the ball away.
33' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
32' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from AC Milan comes to nothing.
32' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
29' Davide Faraoni (Verona) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.

27' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. AC Milan are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
25' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
24' Malick Thiaw (AC Milan) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
23' AC Milan take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
22' The game is interrupted now, Rafael Leao (AC Milan) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

21' What a save from Marco Sportiello! Michael Folorunsho (Verona) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
20' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
17' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Fabio Maresca saw the whole situation.
15' The ball is cleared after Rafael Leao (AC Milan) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
13' Simon Kjaer (AC Milan) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
10' Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

8' 1 - 0 Rafael Leao (AC Milan) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Lorenzo Montipo is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 1:0.
7' Verona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
5' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
